title: Piping & Instrumentation Diagram Register - KC-4501
content:
PIPING & INSTRUMENTATION DIAGRAM (P&ID) REGISTER: KC-4501 (RECYCLE GAS COMPRESSOR).
Document No: TJC-LLD-PID-4501, Title: P&ID: RECYCLE GAS COMPRESSOR (KC-4501) SYSTEM.
Area: 4500 – Gas Recovery & Compression, Functional Location: TJC-LLD-4500-01.
INSTRUMENT & PROCESS CONTROL LOOPS:
- PSLL-4504: Lube oil pressure LOW-LOW (Pressure Switch) [Setpoint: < 1.5 barg]. Function: Trip initiator T1 & Permissive P1. Location: Lube Oil System. Interlock: SEQ-4501 T1/P1
- TSHH-4503: Discharge temperature HIGH-HIGH (Temperature Switch) [Setpoint: > 140 degC]. Function: Trip initiator T2 → SEQ-4501. Location: Compressor Discharge. Interlock: SEQ-4501 T2
- PSHH-4502: Discharge pressure HIGH-HIGH (Pressure Switch) [Setpoint: > 14 barg]. Function: Trip initiator T3 → SEQ-4501. Location: Compressor Discharge. Interlock: SEQ-4501 T3
- VSHH-4505: Crosshead vibration HIGH-HIGH (Vibration Switch) [Setpoint: > 11 mm/s]. Function: Trip initiator T4 → SEQ-4501. Location: Compressor Crosshead. Interlock: SEQ-4501 T4
- LSHH-4510: Suction KO drum level HIGH-HIGH (Level Switch) [Setpoint: > 80 %]. Function: Trip initiator T5 → SEQ-4501. Location: KO Drum FA-4510. Interlock: SEQ-4501 T5
- PSLL-4501: Suction pressure LOW-LOW (Pressure Switch) [Setpoint: < 0.3 barg]. Function: Trip initiator T6 → SEQ-4501. Location: Compressor Suction. Interlock: SEQ-4501 T6
- FT-4506: Seal gas flow Transmitter (Flow Transmitter). Function: Flow measurement & Permissive P2. Location: Seal Gas System. Interlock: SEQ-4501 P2
- LT-4510: KO drum Level Transmitter (Level Transmitter) [Setpoint: < 50 %]. Function: Level measurement & Permissive P3. Location: KO Drum FA-4510. Interlock: SEQ-4501 P3
- FSL-4508: Jacket water flow Switch (Flow Switch). Function: Cooling water flow & Permissive P4. Location: Cooling Water line. Interlock: SEQ-4501 P4
- FV-4502: Anti-Surge Recycle Control Valve (Control Valve) [Setpoint: OPEN —]. Function: EFF-2: Open on Trip / Low Flow. Location: Anti-Surge line. Interlock: SEQ-4501 EFF-2
- XV-4501: Suction Shutdown Valve (On/Off Valve) [Setpoint: CLOSE —]. Function: EFF-3: Close Suction on Trip. Location: Compressor Suction. Interlock: SEQ-4501 EFF-3
- VT-4501: Crosshead vibration transmitter (Vibration Transmitter). Function: Vibration Monitoring (Trend). Location: Compressor Crosshead. Interlock: —
- PT-4501: Suction Pressure Transmitter (Pressure Transmitter). Function: Pressure Monitoring. Location: Compressor Suction. Interlock: —
- PI-1201: Suction Pressure Indicator (Pressure Indicator). Function: Local Pressure Indication. Location: Compressor Suction. Interlock: —
- TIC-4502: Intercooler Temp Controller (Temp Controller). Function: Control intercooler EA-4502. Location: Intercooler EA-4502. Interlock: —
- EA-4502: Intercooler Heat Exchanger (Heat Exchanger). Function: Cools gas between stages. Location: Interstage line. Interlock: —
- PSV-4502: Pressure Safety Valve (Relief Valve). Function: Overpressure protection. Location: Intercooler EA-4502. Interlock: —
- OLL-4504: Lube Oil Pump Relief Valve (Relief Valve) [Setpoint: 2.5 barg]. Function: Set lube oil pump pressure. Location: Lube Oil System. Interlock: —
CROSS REFERENCES: Datasheet: TJC-LLD-DS-KC-4501, Interlock: SEQ-4501.
